front.introHead: From the back of the house
front.intro: Behind this East End bungalow, a covered patio runs beside a large covered garage in the fully fenced yard. The Breakfast Nook opens to the rear deck. Interior laundry is part of the update. Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road are under half a mile away. EaDo is minutes away and Downtown is just 3.5 miles. The Esplanade on Navigation, Original Ninfa's and El Tiempo are just 2 miles away. Mason Park is about 1.7 miles away.

top.title: The Front Rooms, Open to Each Other

leads.name: Living Room
leads.text: The Craftsman-style front door opens right into the room from the covered porch. A wide cased opening leads straight to the Dining area and the Kitchen, so the whole front of the home works as one space. New floors, trim and lighting carry through.

leads.name: Kitchen
leads.text: Everything is new, set up in an L with a peninsula, dark navy lower cabinets and white shaker-style uppers. The sink sits under a window for plenty of natural light. The peninsula adds seating and prep space.

details.name: Dining Area
details.text: From the Dining area, the front door and Living Room are on one side and the Kitchen peninsula is on the other.

details.name: Breakfast Nook
details.text: Windows on two walls and a door to the backyard make this a bright, flexible spot. Wood-look flooring matches the Kitchen.

details.name: Breakfast Bar
details.text: Two pendant lights hang over a stone-look counter with room for barstools along it. The pantry is just around the corner.

details.name: At the Range
details.text: A short hall with wood-look flooring leads back toward the main living area. The hall leads to the hall bath and the bedrooms.

bottom.title: A Vaulted Primary and Two New Baths

lead.name: Primary Bedroom
lead.text: The Primary has the only vaulted ceiling in the home, with an exposed painted beam running the length of the room. Carpet runs wall to wall, with room for a king bed, nightstands and a dresser. The doorway to the Primary Bath is on the closet wall, so the bed, the closet and the bath are a few easy steps apart.

baths.name: Double Vanity
baths.text: Double sinks sit in a marble-look top on a dark navy vanity with plenty of drawers. A high transom window brings in daylight and keeps the room private.

baths.name: Hall Bath
baths.text: A tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround, marble-look tile floors and a window over the tub. Deep built-in linen shelves sit just outside the door.

row.name: Primary Closet
row.text: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower down the center, with hanging rods on both sides. The built-ins stay with the home. Carpet carries into the closet.

row.name: Bedroom 2
row.text: Windows on two walls look out to the neighborhood, so daylight comes in from two directions. It's at the front corner of the home, apart from the Primary at the back.

row.name: Bedroom 3
row.text: A large window brings in natural light, and a reach-in closet sits beside the door. It has space for a queen bed with a nightstand on each side. Carpet runs underfoot.

back.title: The Yard, the Plan and the East End

photos.name: Covered patio and garage
photos.text: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover the space, with a wood plank back wall and a concrete floor. The home also has three-phase power, a plus for heavy-duty equipment.

photos.name: Backyard
photos.text: The fenced backyard has a large mature shade tree and open ground for a garden or outdoor seating. A white wood deck with steps leads out from the Breakfast Nook door.

photos.name: Covered Patio
photos.text: The open patio sits alongside the covered garage, inside the fully fenced yard. From the back of the lot, the rear of the home shows the same new Hardi Plank siding as the front.

back.head: What was done
back.para: New Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover the outside of the home. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced. New flooring, paint and lighting run through the main rooms. A board and batten gable adds detail at the front. Segundo Coffee Lab on Milby Street is about 1.4 miles away.
back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room dimensions are approximate, from the listing's floor plan. Living area of 1,385 square feet per HCAD.

a.text: Come see the bungalow with the board and batten gable. A wide cased opening joins the living room, the dining table and the kitchen, and a clerestory window lights the front room. A covered patio waits out back.

A vaulted ceiling with an exposed beam, windows on two walls, and a double-door closet that shares a wall with the bath.
A covered garage and a covered patio side by side in the fenced yard, with string lights strung across the open patio.

jl.front9: Board and batten covers the front gable, and a stained wood door sits under the covered stoop, with low shrubs along the beds and three steps up. Inside, a wide cased opening joins the living room, the dining table and the L-shaped kitchen, with wood-look floors from the front door to the back hall. The yard is fenced all the way around, and a covered garage and patio share it. You're in the East End, minutes from Downtown, and the house has never flooded.

js.front9: I listed this house, photographed every room, drew a floor plan and had the brochure printed for the first showing. I read every offer with the sellers one line at a time, kept the inspection and the appraisal on their dates, and phoned them each week. On closing day I was at the table when the keys changed hands.

I read every offer with the sellers one line at a time, kept the inspection and the appraisal on their dates, and phoned them each week with what I was hearing from buyers. On closing day I was at the table when the keys changed hands, and I stayed until the sellers had everything they needed.

about: An East End bungalow with a covered garage and a fully fenced yard behind it.
The kitchen and both baths are new, and so are the floors, trim, paint and lighting in the main rooms.
Hardi Plank siding and a board and batten gable face the street, with a new driveway down the side of the lot.
The primary bedroom sits at the back of the house, away from the street.
The breakfast nook has a door to a small deck, and laundry is inside the house.
Telephone Road is close, with Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee under half a mile away.
The roof, wiring and plumbing are new.
